name: InfraDispatch
problem: DMC teams lose time in fragmented pickup, drop-off, guide, driver, and vehicle coordination.
solution: Smart rule-based dispatch planner with operational logic for pickup points, route sequencing, assignments, InfraCluster handoff concepts, and clear team briefing outputs.
useCase: Tourism operations teams, destination management companies, and tour operator transport workflows.
role: Product concept owner, operations workflow designer, and practical implementation planner.
boundary: Static frontend demo with rule-based logic; no production routing API, backend, accounts, or live traffic integration yet.

name: InfraCluster
problem: Large UAE hotel pickups become difficult when different pickup times, hotel areas, adult/child/infant counts, luggage, guide language and vehicle capacity are managed manually.
solution: Hotel pickup clustering MVP that imports CSV/Excel-style group sheets, searches a 7,500+ row static UAE tourism seed database, groups hotels by timing, area, language and passenger count, compares cost signals, then prepares vehicle alternatives and InfraDispatch handoff outputs.
useCase: DMC operations teams, MICE groups, city tours, airport movements, desert safari pickups and dispatch supervisors preparing multi-hotel services.
role: Product concept owner, hotel pickup workflow designer, clustering rule planner and static MVP implementation lead.
boundary: Static frontend MVP with generated UAE tourism seed data, browser-side spreadsheet import, estimated cost signals and JSON handoff; no verified live hotel master database, routing, traffic API, vehicle inventory or guide availability integration yet.

name: InfraSky
problem: Stargazing tours can be oversold when Moon phase, haze, camp lighting, access, guide capability, and guest comfort are checked separately.
solution: UAE-first stargazing operations planner that scores product fit, classifies nights, and generates sales, guide, guest, driver, and SOP outputs.
useCase: DMCs, desert camps, stargazing guides, and tourism product teams planning condition-aware astro-tourism experiences.
role: Product concept owner, tourism operations logic designer, and static prototype builder.
boundary: Static browser prototype with local planning logic; not an astronomy guarantee or live production platform.

name: InfraQuote
problem: Tourism quotations become risky when net cost, selling price, markup, margin, VAT, transport, tickets, gratuities, and break-even assumptions are not clearly separated.
solution: Quotation logic concept that turns tour pricing rules into a structured workflow for cost building, margin control, and client-ready proposal outputs.
useCase: DMC sales teams, tour operators, travel desks, and product teams preparing clear and commercially safe tour quotations.
role: Commercial workflow designer, quotation logic researcher, and article-series author.
boundary: Static frontend MVP with editable sample data and local-storage drafts; real supplier rates, finance policy and backend approval workflow still require implementation.

name: Tourism AI Operations Playbook
problem: Tourism teams need practical AI support, but generic prompt lists often ignore operating context, privacy, missing information, verification and human accountability.
solution: A connected ten-part professional Playbook with 100 responsible, copy-ready AI prompts, structured data, governance templates, version control and an open GitHub contribution workflow.
useCase: DMCs, tour operators, guides, product teams, dispatch, sales, guest-experience, training and quality professionals adopting AI responsibly.
role: Creator, maintainer, tourism operations subject-matter author, prompt-engineering designer and open-project documentation lead.
boundary: AI outputs remain drafts. Dynamic tourism information, privacy, safety, commercial commitments and operational approval require qualified human review.
